datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2014 and spatially referenced to geographic administrative units in Mali. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases derived from standardized IPC methodology applied to survey and secondary data.
